schema_version: 1
name: implement-feature
steps:
  - define acceptance criteria and the owning bounded context
  - identify status, schema, event, HTTP, scoring, and downstream impacts
  - implement through domain/usecase ports and adapters
  - add success, authorization, retry, and partial-failure tests
  - update repository-owned contracts and docs
  - run policy, format, vet, test, and build checks
  - request independent review
